versions.changelog:
- Initial release of FTShare-macro-economy-data skill.
- Unified entry point for querying major macroeconomic indicators for China (15 items) and the US (16 types via single interface).
- Supports user-friendly mapping: identifies user intent and maps common phrases to the correct subskill or parameter.
- Provides clear command-line instructions for both China and US data queries.
- Includes detailed tables of keywords for accurate intent matching and subskill invocation.
